_comment: Binding layer (PROV-DM): collection nodes (prov:Collection) + hadMember. Generic, per-client. groups[].members = qname patterns (* → LIKE %) OR qnames of other collections (nesting = dual-role). questions[] = open structural questions (structure not 100% certain) with a resolution_path.

questions.label: Does Hillside phase 2 fall under the existing building permit or does it need its own?
questions.resolution_path: Confirm with the permitting office; attach the decision as a source document, then `provgraf resolve-question`.
